subject.title: Feishu: @mention not recognized in group when multiple bots share the same group (open_id app-scoped mismatch)

question: Which Feishu bot identity strategy should become canonical for multi-bot group @mention admission when native `open_id` values are app-scoped?
rationale: The current source-level failure is clear, but choosing the permanent identity key needs maintainer intent because `union_id`, cross-app `open_id` collection, app_id-based mapping, and broader Feishu identity/session work have different API, scope, compatibility, and message-delivery implications.

options.title: Rewrite around a proven Feishu identity
options.body: Validate a stable Feishu bot identity source, rebuild the linked PR on current main, and cover text, post, command-stripping, mention-forward, and debounce paths before merge.

options.title: Fold into broader Feishu identity work
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers converge the mention-admission, session-key, and account-boundary model across related Feishu multi-bot reports.

options.title: Document the platform limitation
options.body: If Feishu exposes no reliable cross-app bot identity, document the unsupported targeted multi-app setup and keep current strict open_id matching.

recommendation.title: Rewrite around a proven Feishu identity
recommendation.body: Validate a stable Feishu bot identity source, rebuild the linked PR on current main, and cover text, post, command-stripping, mention-forward, and debounce paths before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the active PR, requested changes on the Feishu identity decision surface, and have recent merged work on the same mention-gating path.
